content: Certain medications may interfere with specific laboratory tests, such as certain urine glucose tests, potentially leading to inaccurate test results. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is not life-threatening, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can call 1-800-222-1222, and in Canada, you can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Storage: Refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist for specific storage guidelines. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider.
